decision:phase10-cloudflare-runtime.decision: Deploy the Vite SPA with Cloudflare Pages and implement /api/contact as functions/api/contact.ts. The Pages adapter forwards request and context.env to the provider-neutral contact handler; unmatched routes retain Pages automatic SPA fallback.
invariants: Do not reintroduce Vercel configuration
Do not add Worker or Wrangler configuration
Do not store RESEND_API_KEY in repository configuration
Pass Pages context.env explicitly into contactServer.ts
Preserve /api/contact as the browser contract
Preserve the six-field contact payload, honeypot, Contact behavior and Booking state machine
Do not add _redirects or _routes.json without demonstrated need
decision:phase10-cloudflare-runtime.rationale: The user confirmed Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare Pages file-based routing maps functions/api/contact.ts to /api/contact while unmatched paths fall through to static asset and SPA behavior.
decision:phase10-cloudflare-runtime.title: Use Cloudflare Pages file routing for the contact endpoint

decision:phase10-launch-contracts.decision: Treat the implemented repository as source of truth; centralize application metadata, remove unreachable stale commercial data, and correct proven accessibility, runtime and unsupported-claim defects without redesigning completed routes. Hosting configuration must be based on evidenced provider architecture rather than inferred from a generic API directory.
invariants: Echo in Ink remains a founder-led creative technology studio combining strategy, design and development
The public capability model remains exactly four items from servicesContent.ts
The engagement model remains exactly Strategy Sessions, Digital Reset and Full Projects
Start a Project routes to /contact and Book a Strategy Session routes to /booking
Strategy Sessions remain standalone, 60-90 minutes and have no public price
Lumo remains Independent Product and Prototype; Vortex remains excluded
/systems means Creative Systems & Tools and /worlds remains secondary
Insights remains primary navigation terminology while The Archive and all editorial URLs remain compatible
No unsupported clients, testimonials, metrics, outcomes, dates, pricing or launch claims may be introduced
decision:phase10-launch-contracts.title: Preserve proven launch contracts while hardening only demonstrated defects

invariants: Larger projects route to /contact
One focused question routes to /booking
Strategy Sessions remain standalone
servicesContent.ts remains the commercial source of truth
No new pricing
Backend-facing Echo Session Request remains unchanged
decision:phase8-conversion-paths.title: Two distinct conversion paths

decision:phase9-editorial-systems.decision: Use one shared ArchivePage for /insights and /archive; keep The Archive as editorial identity; index only real essays and notes without invented dates or cadence; position /systems as Creative Systems & Tools and route commercial Systems & Automation context to /services.
invariants: /insights and /archive render the same editorial entry without redirecting
Existing editorial child URLs remain stable
/systems is not the Systems & Automation capability page
primaryCapabilities remains exactly four
engagementModels remains exactly three
Lumo remains Independent Product / Prototype
decision:phase9-editorial-systems.rationale: This preserves established URLs and editorial character while making the public information architecture and commercial model legible.
decision:phase9-editorial-systems.title: Preserve editorial identity and separate creative resources from commercial automation

finding:phase10-cloudflare-domain-state.resolution: Confirm in Cloudflare DNS and Custom Domains whether apex-only hosting is intentional. If www is desired, add and redirect it through the dashboard without changing application routes.
finding:phase10-cloudflare-domain-state.summary: http://echoin.ink redirects permanently to https://echoin.ink and the apex responds through Cloudflare. https://www.echoin.ink did not resolve during the audit.
finding:phase10-cloudflare-domain-state.title: Cloudflare apex domain works; www hostname is absent

finding:phase10-cloudflare-pages-product.resolution: In Cloudflare Pages, confirm production branch main, build command npm run build, output dist, and RESEND_API_KEY, CONTACT_FROM_EMAIL and CONTACT_TO_EMAIL for relevant environments. After deployment, verify /api/contact returns JSON and perform a separately authorized controlled delivery test.
finding:phase10-cloudflare-pages-product.summary: Repository-side Pages routing and handler behavior are verified, but the repository cannot inspect the Cloudflare Pages production-branch setting, environment bindings, deployed function route, or Resend sender verification and delivery.
finding:phase10-cloudflare-pages-product.title: Cloudflare Pages bindings and live delivery require external verification

finding:phase10-cloudflare-runtime-unres.resolution: The user externally confirmed Cloudflare Pages. The repository now implements the conventional functions/api/contact.ts Pages adapter and documents Pages build and binding requirements.
finding:phase10-cloudflare-runtime-unres.summary: The repository originally did not prove whether Cloudflare Pages or Workers Static Assets hosted the site.
finding:phase10-cloudflare-runtime-unres.title: Cloudflare Pages versus Workers architecture was previously unresolved

finding:phase10-contact-route-unavailabl.resolution: functions/api/contact.ts now exports onRequestPost and onRequest adapters that pass context.request and context.env to handleContactRequest. Six adapter tests cover successful delivery, invalid input, honeypot, missing bindings, Resend failure and unsupported methods. Deployment and live delivery remain external verification steps.
finding:phase10-contact-route-unavailabl.summary: Before the Pages fix, live /api/contact fell through to the SPA because no Cloudflare-compatible function owned the route.
finding:phase10-contact-route-unavailabl.title: Production /api/contact previously lacked a Cloudflare Pages Function

finding:phase10-production-verification.resolution: The user removed vercel.json. The correction removed Vercel documentation and the incompatible top-level api/contact.ts adapter, then recorded Cloudflare runtime selection and contact routing as unresolved deployment work.
finding:phase10-production-verification.summary: The initial Phase 10 pass incorrectly documented Vercel, added vercel.json, and treated api/contact.ts as a deployable serverless route. The user clarified that Echo in Ink is hosted through Cloudflare.
finding:phase10-production-verification.title: Incorrect Vercel deployment assumption

finding:phase8-legacy-booking-pricing.resolution: Repository inspection proved the receiver treats details as free-form message text and does not parse exact duration or price values. Phase 9 migrated the serialized duration to 60-90 minutes and removed the price field without changing the API schema or state machine.
finding:phase8-legacy-booking-pricing.summary: The booking submission previously serialized duration 60 minutes and price $120-$150 NZD while the public Strategy Sessions contract is 60-90 minutes with no published price.
finding:phase8-legacy-booking-pricing.title: Booking payload carried legacy duration and price
